name: headers_v1
spec: Block headers for ladder step 2b: 80 bytes (version, prev hash, merkle root, time, bits, nonce), little-endian; hash = double SHA-256, compared as a little-endian 256-bit number against the target that bits encodes.
source: Mainnet block 973110 from WhatsOnChain (/v1/bsv/main/block/height/973110), 2026-10-29; its merkle root is the one vectors/woc_mainnet_v1.json proves into. Forgeries made from it.

real.explorerFieldsNote: As WhatsOnChain's /block/height/973110 gives them (2026-10-29); the Workshop rebuilds the 80-byte header from these and checks it hashes to `hash`.

noWork.why: block 973110 with nonce+1: its hash is above the target its own bits declare

easyTarget.why: block 973110's fields with bits 207fffff (regtest's easiest target), mined in a moment: meets its own target, fails the Vault's floor
